reviews.author: Andy Shevchenko
reviews.summary: Applied the Reviewed-by tag to indicate that the patch is acceptable as-is.
reviews.raw_body:
On Wed, Oct 28, 2026 at 10:20 AM Dmitry Ilvokhin <d@ilvokhin.com> wrote:
>
> Commit 22302af28d3f ("cleanup: Annotate guard constructors with
> nonnull") added the macro __nonnull_args() to wrap raw compiler
> attribute.
>
> Replace __attribute__((nonnull)) with __nonnull_args() to
> standardize nonnull attribute usage across the tree and keep the
> attribute's quirks in one place rather than open-coded at every call
> site.
>
> Add spaces after the commas in the __nonnull_args() argument list to
> follow the usual coding style (according to checkpatch).

Reviewed-by: Andy Shevchenko <andy@kernel.org>

-- 
With Best Regards,
Andy Shevchenko

2026-10-28.patch_summary: This patch series standardizes the use of __nonnull_args() macro across the kernel by replacing raw compiler attributes in various functions. The changes are made to lib/list_sort.c and include/linux/list_sort.h, where nonnull attribute usage is unified and quirks are kept in one place.
